labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: BOINC is a platform for high-throughput computing on a large scale (thousands or millions of computers).
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Boinc

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG BOINC_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

#Add needed nvidia environment variables for https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-docker
ENV NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES="compute,video,utility"

# global environment settings
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND="noninteractive" \
    CUSTOM_PORT="8080" \
    CUSTOM_HTTPS_PORT="8181" \
    TITLE=BOINC \
    NO_GAMEPAD=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/boinc-icon.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  add-apt-repository ppa:costamagnagianfranco/boinc && \
  if [ -z ${BOINC_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    BOINC="boinc-client"; \
  else \
    BOINC="boinc-client=${BOINC_VERSION}"; \
  fi && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ${BOINC} \
    at-spi2-core \
    boinc-client-opencl \
    boinc-manager \
    bzip2 \
    xz-utils && \
  ln -s libOpenCL.so.1 /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libOpenCL.so && \
  mkdir -p /etc/OpenCL/vendors && \
  echo "libnvidia-opencl.so.1" > /etc/OpenCL/vendors/nvidia.icd && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get clean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /config/.launchpadlib \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/*

# add local files
COPY root/ /

units.name: init-boinc-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# make our folders
mkdir -p \
    /config \
    /dev/input/mice

# clean up old PIDs
rm -rf "/config/BOINC Manager-abc"

if [[ ! -n "$PASSWORD" ]]; then
    echo "**** No auth enabled. To enable auth, you can set the PASSWORD var in docker arguments. ****"
fi

# permissions
chown -R abc:abc \
    /config

units.name: svc-boinc-client
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

exec \
    s6-setuidgid abc /usr/bin/boinc \
    --dir /config

notes.upstream:
## What's Changed
* [client] don't check on android for installed vbox and docker. by @AenBleidd in https://github.com/BOINC/boinc/pull/6668
* [client] on android querying of /proc/stat is forbidden by @AenBleidd in https://github.com/BOINC/boinc/pull/6670
* [client] fix android issue when the client was requested to exit immediately after start by @AenBleidd in https://github.com/BOINC/boinc/pull/6671
* client (Win): if can't run command in one WSL distro, try others by @davidpanderson in https://github.com/BOINC/boinc/pull/6679
* client: parse container names correctly by @davidpanderson in https://github.com/BOINC/boinc/pull/6681
* client: improve 'non-BOINC total CPU usage' measurement by @davidpanderson in https://github.com/BOINC/boinc/pull/6680
* Mac ss tweaks by @CharlieFenton in https://github.com/BOINC/boinc/pull/6688
* client: always show message when resuming computation by @davidpanderson in https://github.com/BOINC/boinc/pull/6691

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/BOINC/boinc/compare/client_release/8.2/8.2.7...client_release/8.2/8.2.8
